historical_commentary.text: WebSTAR as a product line is long discontinued, and 4D's own built-in web server has for many years made a separate WebSTAR integration unnecessary for 4D web deployments, making this note's specific API integration obsolete for current development.
related_updates: WebSTAR has been discontinued for many years; 4D's own built-in web server has long superseded the need for this integration
